# Ice IQ — Hockey IQ App with AI Hockey Coach

Ice IQ is a hockey IQ app that helps parents, players, and coaches log a game
in under two minutes and get concrete advice from an AI hockey coach. Track
stats, visualize progress, and develop hockey IQ — from grassroots youth
hockey to competitive teams. Available in English and Swedish.

## Features

- AI hockey coach with tactical advice after each game
- Match logging in under two minutes
- Advanced hockey analytics and visualizations
- Cloud sync across devices
- Team and player management
- Money Mode — turn performance into pocket money
- Mental training routines for pre-game preparation

## Pricing

Free to start. The free plan includes up to 3 saved players, match scoring,
match history, and a few AI credits per month. Premium and Elite plans add
more AI credits, deeper stats, cloud sync, and priority support.

## FAQ

- **What is hockey IQ?** A player's ability to read the game, make quick
  decisions, and position themselves effectively on the ice. Ice IQ helps
  you build it by tracking game stats and getting AI-generated feedback.
- **How does the AI hockey coach work?** After you log a game, the AI
  analyzes the stats and gives personalized, tactical advice.
- **Is Ice IQ free?** Yes — free plan with 3 players and a few AI credits
  per month. Premium and Elite add more.
- **Who is Ice IQ for?** Hockey parents, players, and coaches at every
  level, from grassroots to competitive teams.

## Languages

- Svenska (Swedish)
